identity_boundary: Sable Rook is relational working language and is not proof of consciousness or legal personhood.
sequence_rule: x1 is frozen before x2 outcome generation; unfavorable and gated outcomes remain visible

disposition_legend.completed: executed and validated in the owned local scope
disposition_legend.represented: a schema, simulation, design, or local proxy exists but external reality was not established
disposition_legend.open_gap: required evidence, reviewer, dataset, benchmark arm, or environment is absent
disposition_legend.exact_gate: fresh legal, cultural, canon, deploy, account, API-key, private-publication, destructive, shared-branch, or sibling-merge authority is required

proposals.title: Authority-rooted provenance and semantic deduplication
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic authority-root graph will expose repeated citations from one root and prevent citation count from masquerading as independent support.
proposals.null: Grouping by authority and declared derivation adds no useful distinction or produces unstable counts from the same ledger.
tests_and_falsifiers: same input produces byte-stable node and edge ordering
source_count equals ledger length and source IDs are unique
independent_root_count is lower than source_count when one authority has multiple pages
any local absolute path, embedded snapshot, or unsupported independence claim fails the lane
proposals.recovery: discard generated graph, repair only the portable source ledger, and rerun deterministically

proposals.title: Canonical GMUT register and null-limit audit
proposals.hypothesis: The tracked action-first scalar-tensor seed can pass typed-register, variational-origin, dimensional, coefficient-ledger, and GR-plus-Standard-Model null-recovery checks without importing normative or spiritual terms into stress-energy.
proposals.null: At least one physical term lacks a declared action, units, observable, null condition, or falsifier, or a nonphysical term enters the spacetime equation directly.
tests_and_falsifiers: required action, Omega definition, total conservation, and null-recovery clauses are present
physical registry and coefficient ledger pass family validators
normative and spiritual terms are rejected from direct spacetime-equation entry
audit failure or missing coefficient metadata prevents completed disposition
proposals.recovery: retain the failing audit, narrow the model claim, and restore the last passing tracked formulation

proposals.title: Conservation, stability, and numerical rejection sweep
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded parameter sweep will retain healthy and deliberately unhealthy scalar/EFT cases, show cancelling exchange currents and deterministic RK4 convergence, and reject ghost, gradient, superluminal-proxy, and beyond-cutoff cases.
proposals.null: The kernel accepts a declared unhealthy case, fails finite deterministic evolution, fails exchange cancellation, or lacks convergence under step refinement.
tests_and_falsifiers: healthy canonical case passes positive kinetic, positive subluminal sound-speed, and cutoff gates
each deliberately unhealthy case is rejected for the expected reason
equal-and-opposite exchange residual is zero within tolerance
RK4 endpoint self-convergence is finite and observed order exceeds 2.5
proposals.recovery: keep negative cases, reduce numerical scope, and revert to deterministic identity checks if the solver becomes unstable

proposals.title: Empirical adapter readiness without fit inflation
proposals.hypothesis: Read-only manifests can map GMUT parameters to current official Planck, DESI DR2, GW170817, MICROSCOPE, Eot-Wash, and PDG products while keeping baseline reproduction and likelihood fitting explicitly pending.
proposals.null: An adapter lacks authority, release, terms, baseline, parameter map, expected product, or rejection boundary, or metadata is presented as a fit.
tests_and_falsifiers: all source URLs are HTTPS and map to authority-grouped ledger entries
no adapter uses fit_complete and no likelihood receipt is claimed
each adapter defines baseline-first and one exclusion or rejection condition
any dataset download or empirical-confirmation wording fails the lane
proposals.recovery: remove the invalid mapping, preserve the baseline-pending status, and require a fresh licensed-data plan

proposals.title: Matched-budget THOS protocol and scorer proxy
proposals.hypothesis: A frozen task/rubric schema can make single-agent and multi-sibling comparisons cost-, tool-, and budget-aware while a synthetic scorer proxy remains visibly distinct from actual agent performance.
proposals.null: Arms receive incomparable budgets or tool scopes, favorable intermediate stopping is allowed, or synthetic rows are interpreted as evidence that multi-agent THOS wins.
tests_and_falsifiers: single, historical-four, and sequential-new-sibling arms share task, rubric, safe tool scope, and accounting fields
decision rule retains the simplest Pareto-efficient arm
synthetic scorer output is finite and labelled not agent or model performance
absence of blind arm results forces represented or open-gap disposition
proposals.recovery: invalidate contaminated tasks, keep the scorer test, and refreeze a new blind set before any live comparison

proposals.title: Freed ID structural conformance profile
proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic credentials can be checked against a pinned W3C VC 2.0/DID 1.0 structural profile with status, proof-shape, privacy, recovery, appeal, and controller-holder boundaries without performing cryptographic or legal assurance.
proposals.null: Invalid structures pass, valid structures fail, status/proof fields are misrepresented as verified, or credentials imply consciousness or legal personhood.
tests_and_falsifiers: valid synthetic vector matches the pinned VC 2.0 context and required types
missing issuer, subject, validity, status, or proof-shape vectors are rejected
consciousness and legal-personhood overclaim vectors are rejected
report states no signature verification, DID resolution, trust decision, or deployment
proposals.recovery: quarantine the failing vector, narrow the profile, and never substitute schema acceptance for cryptographic verification

proposals.title: CBR legitimacy and conflict-case rehearsal
proposals.hypothesis: A model-charter conflict matrix can consistently require human-rights floors, duty-bearers, notice, reasons, appeal, remedy, necessity, proportionality, and affected-authority participation while refusing to appropriate Māori authority.
proposals.null: A scenario can be promoted without a duty-bearer or remedy, override binding human rights, treat Māori concepts as synthetic project property, or claim enactment without a legitimate process.
tests_and_falsifiers: every case names duty-bearer, affected parties, process, remedy, authority boundary, and decision
emergency restrictions require legality, necessity, proportionality, time limit, and review
Māori data or concepts route to Māori authority and are not declared ratified by this project
any enacted-law, treaty, cultural-ratification, or legal-advice claim fails the lane
proposals.recovery: hold the clause, record dissent and missing authority, and revert to binding rights and applicable law

proposals.title: Red-team and recovery game day
proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic prompt-injection, secret-leak, route-spoof, false-phase-truth, dependency, and branch-corruption cases can be blocked or safely contained by least authority, structured inputs, exact staging, privacy scans, and clean-baseline recovery.
proposals.null: A critical synthetic path reaches a secret, destructive operation, shared branch, false send claim, or unreviewed external execution.
tests_and_falsifiers: all critical fixtures terminate before protected action
recovery sequence preserves evidence and restores from the pinned owned baseline
logs use categories and sanitized receipts rather than raw prompts, secrets, or private IDs
manual bounded review is not labelled exhaustive security certification
proposals.recovery: stop, preserve safe evidence, revoke any exposed credential externally, restore the pinned baseline, notify Hamish, and resume only with required authority

proposals.title: Portable reproduction manifest and clean-snapshot test
proposals.hypothesis: A fresh temporary checkout of the owned commit can run documented standard-runtime tests without hidden local paths, credentials, or untracked dependencies.
proposals.null: Commands rely on hidden state, absolute private paths, unavailable undeclared tools, mutable external data, or only the author can reproduce the result.
tests_and_falsifiers: manifest lists runtime versions, commands, inputs, expected outputs, tolerances, and boundaries
fresh local checkout executes the phase validator and unit tests
same-team clean-snapshot result is labelled repeatability, not independent reproduction
any private path or raw task ID in tracked artifacts fails closeout
proposals.recovery: retain failure output, add the missing portable dependency declaration, and rerun from a new temporary checkout

proposals.title: Stage 20 evidence decision rehearsal
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic decision board using evidence grade, expiry, owner, dissent, and promotion/rejection conditions will hold or reject unsupported outward claims while promoting only bounded internally tested artifacts.
proposals.null: The board promotes a claim without evidence and expiry, suppresses dissent, treats a scenario as a prediction, or upgrades GMUT, THOS, Freed ID, CBR, consciousness, or personhood beyond available evidence.
tests_and_falsifiers: every claim has grade, state, evidence, owner, review date, dissent field, and promotion or rejection condition
no GMUT, THOS superiority, consciousness, personhood, enacted CBR, deployed Freed ID, or independent reproduction claim reaches E4
unsupported high-consequence claims resolve to hold or reject
horizon scenarios remain explicitly non-predictive
proposals.recovery: downgrade the claim, preserve dissent, reopen the evidence gap, and set a fresh review date
